The planet was the second capital of the Corrino Empire. The seat of the empire was moved from the original House Corrino seat, Salusa Secundus, which became the prison and training ground for the imperial Sardaukar.

page.overview:
What is Kaitain?

The planet was the second capital of the Corrino Empire. The seat of the empire was moved from the original House Corrino seat, Salusa Secundus, which became the prison and training ground for the imperial Sardaukar.

Above Padishah Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV's door on Kaitain were the words 'Law is the ultimate science'. The Hall of Portraits was a location, presumably on Kaitain, containing the Ego-likeness of prominent figures. Shaddam brought his eldest daughter Irulan into the hall in 10190 AG and showed her the portrait of Leto Atreides I, lamenting that Irulan had not been of age when Leto was looking for a partner.

After the fall of Corrino Empire in the Desert War, House Corrino left Kaitain and moved back to Salusa Secundus.
